selection.limitation: Descriptive coverage of this finite batch, not species counting or a learned optimal selector.

limits: Finite deterministic parameter/initial-state search, not biological species or learned adaptation.
q is fixed-grid environmental occupancy; it changes growth but has no external label, reward or memory acquisition.
All body rules fixed during life; mixing weight, coupling and initial body vary only in outer generation.
Original r2 seed retains paired-Orbium ancestry. New seed is the same analytical field under both exact kernel families.
Integer whole-field registration is a motif translation diagnostic; residual includes subpixel motion and independent body movement.
Relative change can spike when mass approaches zero; mass, extinction time and absolute tail L1 are provided, not interpreted as sustained activity.
Multiwindow selector is a descriptive coverage heuristic. Different selected IDs are not evidence of superior long-term yield.
No timestep refinement in this batch; prior unrelated single-kernel sensitivity remains a warning against convergence claims.
Saturation is reported directly; nonzero mass or finite activity does not establish a stable organism.
